title: Event-informed one-field-line input for the 2013 April 11 Earth comparison
scientific_use: Run linked srcSEP Parker transport with values reported by Liu et al. and compare the result with Earth observations in Figure 12; do not claim to reproduce the unpublished global SOFIE state.

publication.title: Physics-based Simulation of the 2013 April 11 Solar Energetic Particle Event

reported_parameters_used.shock_source_time_dependence: Earth thermal energy density in Figure 12(d); the paper states injected particle number is proportional to this quantity

nominal_solar_radius_m.purpose: convert the paper's 2.5 solar-radii boundary to SI

astronomical_unit_m.purpose: convert observer radius and mean free path to SI

solar_sidereal_rotation_period_days.purpose: construct the reduced equatorial Parker spiral

field_geometry.reason: the paper does not release its time-dependent Earth-connected AWSoM field line; this is a transparent one-dimensional heliospheric geometry, not a surrogate SOFIE result

solar_wind_profile.reason: use the event-specific Earth value in Liu et al. Table 2 rather than a generic 400 km/s default

shock_trajectory.value: radial constant-speed propagation from 2.5 solar radii at 675 km/s
shock_trajectory.reason: 675 km/s is the paper's EEGGL input speed; the unpublished shock trajectory is not reconstructed or fitted

source_sampling.value: exact piecewise-linear inversion of the vector Figure 12(d) Earth trace
source_sampling.reason: preserve the published time dependence without inventing an exponential source

observer.reason: represent outward flux through the Earth location on one field line

inner_boundary.reason: avoid artificial reinjection of sunward pseudo-particles

comparison_amplitude.reason: the paper does not publish shock surface area or the flux-tube collection area needed to predict absolute pfu from a one-dimensional source; no time-, energy-, or instrument-specific fitting is allowed

digitized_inputs_and_observations.figure_pdf: Fig/1304_Fig12_Spectrum_V8.pdf in the arXiv source distribution
digitized_inputs_and_observations.method: read Matplotlib vector paths after PDF-to-SVG conversion; calibrate against embedded logarithmic grid coordinates

observational_cautions: Only Earth measurements are used; STEREO-B measurements belong to a different connected field line.
The paper background-subtracts the observations and notes SOHO high-flux saturation.
ACE/EPAM has no ion discrimination and the low-energy channels can contain contamination; formal scoring therefore begins at 1 MeV.
The horizontal bars in Figure 12 are energy-bin limits, not statistical error bars.
missing_required_inputs: The evolving Earth-connected AWSoM magnetic-field line and solar-wind profiles
The three-dimensional CME shock position, normal, compression ratio, and thermal state along that line
The shock surface area and flux-tube collection area required for absolute one-dimensional injection normalization
Author-produced numerical tables underlying Figure 12 and the instrument preprocessing workflow
The complete SWMF/SOFIE run deck, restart state, source revision, solver controls, and random state
completion_rule: XM03 is complete as a documented reduced srcSEP-versus-observation validation case, but reproduction_status remains partial for the original global simulation. Never describe the Parker reconstruction as an exact SOFIE replay.
